cli_help.stdout:
usage: story.py [-h] [--version]
                {template,init,status,migrate,audit,world-save,world-check,world-read,cache-get,cache-put,history-dependencies,history-deps,history-inspect,history-publish,history-refresh,history-saved,history-snapshot,history-start,history-state,history-update,export,assemble-short,notes,plan,context,prepare,reconcile,recall,chapter-read,dependencies,sources,lint,commit,adopt,adopt-backfill,ingest,coverage,next,record,findings,source-read,report}
                ...

Story Codex: local, bounded context and transactional writing state. No API
calls.

positional arguments:
  {template,init,status,migrate,audit,world-save,world-check,world-read,cache-get,cache-put,history-dependencies,history-deps,history-inspect,history-publish,history-refresh,history-saved,history-snapshot,history-start,history-state,history-update,export,assemble-short,notes,plan,context,prepare,reconcile,recall,chapter-read,dependencies,sources,lint,commit,adopt,adopt-backfill,ingest,coverage,next,record,findings,source-read,report}
    template            Print just one JSON input example
    init                Create state once; never overwrite an existing book
    status              Compact checkpoint and export health
    migrate             Explicit schema upgrade with a consistent rollback
                        backup
    audit               Hash every managed export and report conflicts
    world-save          Save structured story state with cited evidence
    world-check         Check recorded rules, knowledge and continuity
    world-read          Inspect one stored narrative record, including stale
                        evidence for reviewed repair
    cache-get           Versioned dependencies, reviewed historical branches,
                        and evidence-bound caches
    cache-put           Versioned dependencies, reviewed historical branches,
                        and evidence-bound caches
    history-dependencies
                        Versioned dependencies, reviewed historical branches,
                        and evidence-bound caches
    history-deps        Versioned dependencies, reviewed historical branches,
                        and evidence-bound caches
    history-inspect     Versioned dependencies, reviewed historical branches,
                        and evidence-bound caches
    history-publish     Versioned dependencies, reviewed historical branches,
                        and evidence-bound caches
    history-refresh     Versioned dependencies, reviewed historical branches,
                        and evidence-bound caches
    history-saved       Versioned dependencies, reviewed historical branches,
                        and evidence-bound caches
    history-snapshot    Versioned dependencies, reviewed historical branches,
                        and evidence-bound caches
    history-start       Versioned dependencies, reviewed historical branches,
                        and evidence-bound caches
    history-state       Versioned dependencies, reviewed historical branches,
                        and evidence-bound caches
    history-update      Versioned dependencies, reviewed historical branches,
                        and evidence-bound caches
    export              Repair exports without replacing outside edits
    assemble-short      Assemble all committed short-story chapters into one
                        book-title text file
    notes               Save cards or a chapter plan with optimistic
                        concurrency
    plan                Save cards or a chapter plan with optimistic
                        concurrency
    context             Build a bounded chapter context packet
    prepare             Read-only review scaffold bound to the current book,
                        state and draft
    reconcile           Inspect an outside edit of the latest native chapter,
                        or apply its reviewed draft
    recall              Bounded literal substring search of cards, summaries
                        and chapter prose
    chapter-read        Read a bounded excerpt of a current or immutable
                        historical chapter
    dependencies        Resolve candidate evidence hashes for a reviewed
                        chapter dependency declaration
    sources             Find saved source IDs and analysis checkpoints after a
                        new session
    lint                Check, commit, or import one last complete chapter
    commit              Check, commit, or import one last complete chapter
    adopt               Check, commit, or import one last complete chapter
    adopt-backfill      Check, commit, or import one last complete chapter
    ingest              Snapshot source text and split without losing bonus
                        chapters
    coverage            Incremental source analysis and evidence-backed
                        checkpoints
    next                Incremental source analysis and evidence-backed
                        checkpoints
    record              Incremental source analysis and evidence-backed
                        checkpoints
    findings            Incremental source analysis and evidence-backed
                        checkpoints
    source-read         Incremental source analysis and evidence-backed
                        checkpoints
    report              Incremental source analysis and evidence-backed
                        checkpoints

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
